title: Service Providers: register aur boot
objectives: Naya provider banana aur register karna

sections.heading: Service provider kya hai?
sections.body: Service provider woh jagah hai jahan application **start hone par** cheezein set up hoti hain: container bindings, event listeners, routes, view settings. Laravel ke apne saare features (database, queue, validation, routing) bhi providers se hi boot hote hain, isliye inhe Laravel ke bootstrap ka dil kehte hain.

callout.text: Agar tumhe app shuru hote hi kuch tayyar karna hai, to jawab hamesha service provider hai.

sections.heading: register() aur boot()
sections.body:
Har provider mein do main methods hote hain:

- **`register()`** – sirf container mein cheezein bind karo. Yahan doosri services use mat karo, kyunki abhi sab providers register nahi hue.
- **`boot()`** – sab providers register hone ke baad chalta hai. Yahan kisi bhi service ko use kar sakte ho (routes, events, model settings, view composers).

Lifecycle mein pehle sab `register`, phir sab `boot` chalte hain.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Payment provider
sections.body: Payment se jude saare bindings aur settings ek hi provider mein rakho. Isse `AppServiceProvider` saaf rehta hai.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Contracts\PaymentGateway;
use App\Services\RazorpayGateway;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

class PaymentServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        $this->app->bind(PaymentGateway::class, RazorpayGateway::class);
    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // Yahan routes, events ya settings ka setup aata hai
    }
}

explain: `make:provider` Laravel 11+ mein naye provider ko `bootstrap/providers.php` mein khud jodta hai. Phir bhi file check kar lena.
Agar provider yahan listed nahi hai, to woh chalega hi nahi.

sections.heading: boot() mein kya karte hain?
sections.body: `AppServiceProvider::boot()` chhote global settings ke liye achhi jagah hai. Jaise development mein lazy loading ke galat use ko pakadne ke liye:

versionDiff.heading: Providers kahan register hote hain
versionDiff.intro: Provider ka kaam same hai. Register karne ki jagah Laravel 11 se badal gayi.

items.11: `bootstrap/providers.php` mein list. Laravel 10 ki tarah `config/app.php` ke `providers` array mein nahi.
items.13: Same. User-defined providers `bootstrap/providers.php` mein hi rehte hain.

errors.error: Provider ka code chal hi nahi raha
errors.fix: Provider class ko `bootstrap/providers.php` ki array mein jodo.

errors.error: register() mein kisi doosri service ko use karne par error
errors.cause: `register()` ke waqt baaki providers abhi register nahi hue.
errors.fix: Wahan sirf `bind`/`singleton` karo. Service use karni ho to `boot()` mein karo.

errors.cause: Namespace ya file ka naam galat hai.
errors.fix: Namespace `App\Providers` aur file `app/Providers/PaymentServiceProvider.php` check karo, phir `composer dump-autoload`.

quiz.q: Providers ki list Laravel 11+ mein kahan hoti hai?
quiz.why: User-defined providers `bootstrap/providers.php` mein listed hote hain.
`register()` mein sirf bindings, doosri services use mat karo.

options: Ek provider ka dono, phir doosre ka
quiz.why: Pehle sab providers ka `register`, uske baad sab ka `boot`.

interview.a: Woh class jo application ko bootstrap karti hai: bindings, events, routes, settings. Laravel ke saare core features bhi providers se load hote hain.
`register()` sirf container binding ke liye, jab baaki providers ready nahi. `boot()` sab register hone ke baad chalta hai aur kisi bhi service ko use kar sakta hai.
`php artisan make:provider Name` aur `bootstrap/providers.php` mein listed hona chahiye (Laravel 11+ mein command khud jod deti hai).

interview.q: Laravel 10 aur 11 mein providers register karne ka farak?
interview.a: Laravel 10 mein `config/app.php` ke `providers` array mein. Laravel 11+ mein `bootstrap/providers.php` mein.
Chhote application-wide bindings aur settings. Badi cheezon ke liye alag providers banao.

summary: Provider application ke startup ka setup hai.
`register()` mein sirf bindings, `boot()` mein baaki setup.
Alag topics ke liye alag providers rakho.
